title: CP-2 Onboarding v1alpha1
description: POST /api/v1/onboarding (unsigned; the one-time token authorises it). Request = $defs/OnboardingRequest, 201 response = $defs/OnboardingResponse. The engine (Engine.onboard) refuses a response whose cloudPublicKey differs from its provisioned trust anchor (cfg cloudPublicKey) and then stays un-onboarded.
$comment: Both objects closed except that the response may carry more keys in later v1alpha1 revisions (additive); the engine reads only cloudPublicKey.

Ed25519PublicKey.description: base64 of the raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key.

publicKey.description: Device key (generated on first start, dataDir/device.key, 0600).

token.description: One-time token issued by POST /api/v1/admin/onboarding-tokens for exactly this deviceId.

cloudPublicKey.description: Must equal the device's provisioned cloudPublicKey.
